newsitem.title: USA: Terra May revenues 15 pct over year-ago.
newsitem.headline: Terra May revenues 15 pct over year-ago.

text.p: Terra Industries Inc on Tuesday reported May revenues of $466.4 million, up 15 percent from $403.6 million in May last year.

Year-to-date revenues totaled $1.28 billion compared with the $1.13 billion reported for the first five months of 1996, said Terra, which reports revenues monthly for its second quarter. More than 50 percent of its sales of fertilizer, agricultural chemicals and seed occur during this period.
Revenues from Terra's distribution operations were $380.4 million, versus $333.3 million a year ago, the company said.

Nitrogen products experienced a 19 percent gain in revenue for May to $76.7 million from $64.3 million last May. Methanol revenues for the month were $12.3 million, compared with revenues of $11.8 million in May 1996, Terra said.

"In May, significant planting progress was achieved in most of the company's markets, with planting of the major crops -- corn and soybeans -- well ahead of the five-year average for the month," Terra said.
